## 判断

- 高斯剪枝减少的是对场景重建贡献微小的高斯数量，从而降低冗余。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_0c78f5d4bd5e337229fce3a4e88ea857b5794c80347a851738dbb878870be8be) [2](#research-evidence-ev_3f807418dc5b26f84ed68bad17741f3f196207dc80d14fde16709db580a9e7d0)
- SH降阶减少的是球谐函数的阶数，从而简化光照模型。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_0c78f5d4bd5e337229fce3a4e88ea857b5794c80347a851738dbb878870be8be)

论文事实已按所列原文核对。

<details>
<summary>原文依据</summary>

**[1] LightGaussian: Unbounded 3D Gaussian Compression with 15x Reduction and 200+ FPS** · 第 8 页 · 全文片段

> Results show that Gaussian Pruning and Recovery effectively removes redundant Gaussians, retaining only those crucial for scene representation. SH Distillation reduces the Spherical Harmonics degree, simplifying the lighting model with minimal quality loss.

**[2] LightGaussian: Unbounded 3D Gaussian Compression with 15x Reduction and 200+ FPS** · 第 8 页 · 全文片段

> In this method, we prune Gaussians that contribute minimally to scene reconstruction, reducing redundancy while preserving visual fidelity.

</details>

## 判断

- 高斯剪枝若仅按不透明度等简单标准删除高斯，可能误删承载重要场景细节的高斯，导致建模质量下降。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_a7a18d4a3bd88ee3cac0c62b07b423d7b7095e3d4657b7097a5206c85e6f700d)
  适用条件：context：剪枝标准为简单标准（如不透明度）；被删高斯承载重要场景细节。
